title: [Attention][Feature] Integrate mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla op for DeepSeek-V4 FP8 KV path
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Unify the DSV4 sparse attention path on the MixedQuantSparseFlashMla operator family from cann_ops_transformer, replacing the previous in-tree custom operators:
- Remove the in-tree KvCompressEpilog custom op (csrc/attention/kv_compress_epilog/ — kernel, tiling, host def, CMake and torch bindings) and switch dsa_kv_compress_scatter to the cann_ops_transformer.kv_compress_epilog op, which writes the PA_BBND quantMode=1 layout (608 B/token: [rope(64 bf16=128B) | nope(448 fp8) | scale(7 bf16=14B) | pad(18B)]) directly.
- Replace the npu_kv_quant_sparse_attn_sharedkv(_metadata) ops in the DSV4 FP8 plan with new adapter entry points mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla_fp8 / mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla_metadata_fp8 (quantMode=1, PA_BBND), and rename the existing TurboQuant adapters to mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla_turboquant / mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla_metadata_turboquant (quantMode=3). Both paths now share the same MixedQuantSparseFlashMla operator.
- Match the new cache layout: FP8 SWA cache row shrinks from head_dim + 128 to head_dim + 96 (608 B/token), updating deepseek_v4/model.py, layer/attention/layer.py and the DSV4 compressed block-size tables.
- Avoid NPU→CPU syncs in the hot path: max_seqlen_cmp_kv and the full-coverage window right edge are derived from host-side max_seqlen_kv / total_q_tokens instead of .item() on device tensors; total_q_tokens is added to the DSA kwargs (dsa_v1.py, context_parallel/dsa_cp.py).

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. Behavior is preserved for existing DSV4 (FP8) and TurboQuant sparse-attention deployments; the change is internal (operator backend swap + adapter refactor).

### How was this patch tested?


- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c4df37dfcc7f72ca41cd43801a468526ecf99a2b
